title: Upgrade DiffModal to V3 Hybrid Merge Workbench (hide identical, word-diff, per-axis merge, seed safety lock)

sections.what: Upgrade static/js/shared/diff-modal.ts and routes/library_ops.py from the raw A -> A list modal into the V3 Hybrid Merge Workbench demonstrated in diff_modal_demo_v3_hybrid.html.
sections.why: The current DiffModal floods the screen with 20+ identical A -> A fields and memories, dumps raw JSON blobs for stats/skills/relationships, truncates memory text, and marks world-only seed memories as '-' removals without safety locks.
sections.how:
1. Upgrade static/js/shared/diff-modal.ts to the V3 Hybrid Merge Workbench layout (fluid clamp/vh modal, KPI bucket strip for Conflicts / World-Only / New / Identical, side-by-side / inline word-diff for prose, full untruncated memory rows).
2. Add per-axis Smart Merge support for relationships/stats/skills (e.g. keep live closeness/interaction_count/label while adopting missing multi-axis fields from library) and wire _apply_entry_selection in routes/library_ops.py.
3. Protect world-only items (especially seed memories) as Keep Safe by default unless explicitly marked Delete (or Promote in World -> Library mode), and add bulk facet buttons (Keep all seed, filter by #tag).
4. Add dry-run summary preview, clear direction banner (Library -> World vs World -> Library), and UndoHistory snapshot hook on Apply.
sections.verify: Run npm run build:ts, JS unit tests for DiffModal/template-sync, and pytest on routes/library_ops.py; verify live in Character Inspector Refresh from Library for kyrie johansen.

acceptance.text: DiffModal uses a fluid widescreen layout and hides identical (=) fields/memories/relationships by default with a toggle to inspect them.
Prose fields render inline word-level diffs (-old/+new), structured objects (relationships, stats, skills) support per-axis Smart Merge, and memories render full untruncated text.

World-only items (such as seed memories) are protected by default (Keep Safe) instead of silently queued for deletion, with bulk facet chips, bidirectional mode clarity, dry-run preview, and UndoHistory integration.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Shared DiffModal (static/js/shared/diff-modal.ts) invoked from Refresh from Library and Save to Library.

Manual verification steps:
1. Open Character Inspector for kyrie johansen and click Refresh from Library.
   - expected: Full-screen V3 Hybrid Merge Workbench opens with identical items hidden by default, per-axis Smart Merge on lulu ashford, and seed memories protected as Keep Safe.
